name: zotero-mcp
description: Official Local API-first Zotero MCP server for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex to local Zotero tools.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Zotero 10+ through the official Local API. Write authorization is granted inside Zotero and is not stored in Codex configuration.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Zotero MCP to search or update my Zotero library.
